summary: Cost per hour of drive time; effective only when options.objective.travel_cost = duration.
range: Integer. Default 3600. Mutually exclusive with per_km.
businessRules: per_hour defines: Define the cost for one hour of drive time of the vehicle. When per_hour cost is used, the final vehicle cost is determined based on the given value, instead of travel duration of the route. Please…
Must stay consistent with: vehicles.costs.per_km, options.objective. Changes here may require validation of those fields.
Rule: Cost/distance/duration matrices must have consistent dimensions and indices.
Numeric field; verify sign (positive/negative) and unit from spec.
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
testingGuidance: Interaction: Behavioral: per_km cost ignored unless travel_cost=distance.
